= Workflows in this repository

WARNING: no workflow in this directory can start today. Every run in this repository
fails at startup, before any step — including a probe whose only content was
`run: echo` — so a green tick is not available as evidence here until Actions is
enabled for the repository (owner-side: Settings → Actions → General). See
`docs/FINDINGS.adoc` §F9. `tools/selfcheck.sh` covers everything that can be checked
without a runner, and prints `SKIP` rather than passing silently.

[cols="1,2,3",options="header"]
|===
| Workflow | What it decides | How it can fail you

| `ci.yml` | Tests pass, this repo passes its own language gate, the Containerfile meets the container floor, every workflow parses.
| Julia 1.10 is a supported floor; a stdlib API change can break it while 1.11 is green. `fail-fast: false` keeps both visible.

| `secret-scanner.yml` | No credentials in the tree.
| Calls the estate reusable at a pinned commit. If that pin is moved to `@main` it stops being auditable; if `secrets: inherit` is dropped the scan degrades silently to a pass.
|===

Deliberately absent, with reasons in `../../docs/FINDINGS.adoc`:

* *CodeQL* — three estate issues are open on default-setup vs committed
  configurations colliding (`hyperpolymath/standards#1031`, `#1033`, `#1037`);
  adding a second scanning lane here would reproduce that. Note the asymmetry this
  leaves: the org's `EstateBranching` ruleset names CodeQL as a *required* scanning
  tool with `alerts_threshold: errors`, no CodeQL analysis has ever been reported for
  this repository, and the merge still went through — an unsatisfied requirement that
  enforces nothing (`../../docs/FINDINGS.adoc` §F11).
* *Hypatia scan* — the reusable at the pin other repos use emits no SARIF
  (`hyperpolymath/standards#1050`), so a green check here would mean nothing.
* *The estate `language-gate` reusable* — `hyperpolymath/.github` publishes no
  `language-gate.yml` (`§F8`), so the upstream caller template cannot be used
  without inventing a URL. This repository is where that gate's semantics live
  instead; adopting it org-wide is a separate decision for the owner.
